description.value:
You conjure a 20-foot-radius sphere of icy, semi-solid fog centered on a point you can see. The fog wraps around corners, heavily obscures its area, and counts as difficult terrain. A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn, or starts its turn there, takes 4d6 cold damage and gains 1 slowed level until the end of that turn.

The fog persists for the duration or until scattered by a wind of at least moderate speed (10 mph or faster).

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 6
